subject: Cohort subsidy structure, invoice split, and monthly usage ceiling
messages:
From: Alex Byrne <alex@orbitstartups.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance <finance@orbitstartups.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Cohort support: subsidy split + invoicing question

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week — OrbitStart is excited about Redwood's latency and cost controls. We're lining up funding for our accelerator cohort (June start), and the partner team asked whether Redwood can do two things for the cohort pilot:

1) Provide a $12k cohort subsidy that we can split across the 8 founders (so each org gets a $1.5k voucher on sign-up).
2) Issue a single invoice to OrbitStart for the full cohort subsidy (we will manage internal allocations and reporting).

Two follow-ups from our side: do you (a) require per-org billing when applying promo credits, or can you accept a single pre-paid invoice and have us distribute unique voucher codes? And (b) do you impose a usage ceiling per voucher that we should communicate to founders?

If it's helpful I can loop in our finance lead (cced). We're on a tight timeline — would love to finalize by Friday so founders have clear onboarding instructions.

Best,
Alex Byrne
Program Director, OrbitStart

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Byrne <alex@orbitstartups.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort support: subsidy split + invoicing question

Alex — great to hear, and congrats on the upcoming cohort. Short answers up front: yes, we can accept a single pre-paid invoice for the total cohort subsidy and we can create unique voucher codes for each founder; usage ceilings are configurable per-code.

Couple of details we should align on before I sign off:
- Billing flow: Invoice to OrbitStart for $12,000 (one-time) paid up front or net-30. Finance (Monica) can confirm whether Redwood needs a PO or special billing contact.
- Voucher model: We can issue 8 unique promo codes tied to the OrbitStart deal id (RDW-1892). Codes can expire at a date you choose; they can also carry a monthly usage cap or a lifetime cap.
- Overages: Once a voucher is exhausted, the org's own card (if added) will be billed; we can also set automatic trial-to-paid reminders.
- Accounting: For your internal reporting, we will supply a consolidated redemption report and per-code redemption breakdown.

Ben — can you weigh in on whether we should require a PO for cohort invoices > $10k? Monica — can you confirm the invoice lineage (RDW vendor code, remit to, and whether we need any special language for OrbitStart's finance team)?

I attached a short pricing matrix and a draft SOW to this thread — please review. If we can align on invoice timing and the cap strategy today, I'll generate the codes and the invoice.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: RDW-SOW-draft.pdf (1 page stub), cohort-pricing-table.xlsx (pricing stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Alex Byrne <alex@orbitstartups.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 10:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort support: subsidy split + invoicing question

Thanks Lauren — quick ops note from pricing: we can do the $12k as a one-time pre-paid credit. For internal controls I'd recommend we:

- Issue 8 single-use voucher codes, each with a $1.5k lifetime cap.
- Set an optional soft monthly ceiling at $400/month to minimize surprise redemptions; founders can request temporary lifts (manual) if needed.
- Tax/treatment: we treat pre-paid credits as deferred revenue and will require a billing contact and remit address on the invoice.

We usually do PO optional for partners with a contract; if OrbitStart prefers net-30 via PO, we'll accept it but need the PO # on the invoice. Otherwise, payment up front clears faster and the codes go live immediately.

Happy to coordinate code creation once finance confirms remit details.

—Ben
Head of Growth Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Alex Byrne <finance@orbitstartups.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort support: subsidy split + invoicing question

Alex / OrbitStart finance — thanks for the patience. For the invoice and recognition:

1) Redwood requires either (a) payment in full at issuance or (b) a PO with net-30 terms. If you choose PO/net-30 please provide the PO number and the remit address exactly as it should appear on the invoice.
2) Invoice will reference Deal: RDW-1892 and line item: "OrbitStart Cohort Subsidy (8 x $1.5k vouchers)". We will mark the invoice as pre-paid credits.
3) Codes: once payment or valid PO is received we'll issue 8 unique voucher codes tied to that invoice number. Each code will have a lifetime cap of $1,500. We can add an optional soft monthly cap of $400 on each code — please confirm if you want that enabled.
4) Deliverables: we'll provide a redemption CSV each Monday during the cohort and a final usage report at the end of the subsidy window (or upon request).

I've attached a minimal SOW and the draft invoice template for your legal/finance review. If you confirm payment preference (pre-pay vs PO/net-30) and whether to enable the soft monthly caps, we can finalize and send the invoice by close of business Monday.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
